name: run_date
description: The dt the run processed. Partition key.

name: dag_run_id
description: Airflow run id. Rows are replaced per (run_date, dag_run_id), so a retry overwrites only its own attempt and earlier forensics survive.

name: layer
description: stage | core. Qualifies check_name, which is why names need no layer prefix.

name: check_name
description: Stable slug, unique within a layer, e.g. id_is_integer.

name: severity
description: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW. HIGH fails the run; MEDIUM and LOW are recorded only.

name: rows_affected
description: Number of rows violating the rule. Only violations are written to this table, so this is > 0 except for whole-partition rules such as partition_not_empty.

name: observed_value
description: Measured value for rules where a raw row count is not the point.

name: sample
description: JSON array of up to 5 offending issue keys, so a violation names the rows instead of only counting them.

name: message
description: Human-readable description of what the rule enforces.

name: etl_ts
description: UTC time the rule was evaluated. Same meaning as etl_ts on stage and core.
